description:
DharmikVibes' bookable pujas that are listed right now: title, temple, place, open dates, time slots,
    languages, and the dharmikvibes.com page where it is booked. The price appears only as listed on the
    website; this tool never works one out. It books nothing.

on_or_after.description: ISO date. Only pujas with an open date on or after it.
on_or_after.title: On Or After

query.description: Words from the puja name, temple or place, in English or Hindi, for example Vindhyachal, Bhairav, Kashi.
query.title: Query

name: search_pujas

book_url.description: The puja page on dharmikvibes.com, where it is booked
book_url.title: Book Url

code.description: DharmikVibes service code, for example DVA_040
code.title: Code

dates.description: Open dates from today, ISO format
dates.title: Dates

listed_price_inr.description: Price as listed on dharmikvibes.com, only when the owner's switch is on; never computed
listed_price_inr.title: Listed Price Inr

title: Pujas you can book
